channel.title: ZeroToAct Signals
channel.description: One read a week on the shifts in money, government policy and the world economy that change your next move.

item.title: The Demographic Shift
item.description: Africa's youth are the century's demographic engine. Position before the consensus does.

item.title: The $700 Billion Compute Divide
item.description: US tech is preparing nearly $700 billion in capital spending. Africa's data-centre market is a fraction of it.

item.title: The Africa Window
item.description: A cracked dollar just opened a financing window for Africa. Debt is carrying it, equity has thinned to a seven-year low.

item.title: DFIs Have Stopped Writing Equity Cheques in Africa
item.description: Development finance has stopped writing equity cheques in Africa. It is lending instead.

item.title: The Fed Might Hike on July 29, Not Cut
item.description: The Fed might hike on July 29, not cut. If the dollar tightens, every African founder's runway maths just changed.

item.title: The US Economy Dominating Through Service
item.description: US power is a service system. It profits by being irreplaceable to everyone else's success.
